_comment: THE PANEL. The Hauler idles on sunlight, so the panel is the part that defines it.

TEACHES NOTHING (#390). Teardown yields FUNCTION now, not knowledge; the market is the only source of tier knowledge. The pools below are unchanged - a teardown is never a total loss once you already have the part.
A dead Scrap Hauler, found in Bulky Waste: the hull, the board, the tread rubber. Four
draws, no filler, so a teardown always hands something back.
NO COMPONENT IN THIS POOL. The Solar Panel is the signature result at the top level and
comes out every time; a component that also appeared here would arrive twice from one find.
